ex.en: In this way, we waste a lot of time.
ex.zh: 這樣的話我們會浪費很多時間。

ex.en: The time you enjoy wasting is not wasted time.
ex.zh: 你享受浪費的時間，就不算浪費。

ex.en: Tom regretted having wasted a great deal of his life.
ex.zh: 湯姆很後悔自己浪費了大半輩子。

ex.en: The factory waste gave rise to serious environmental pollution.
ex.zh: 工廠廢棄物造成了嚴重的環境污染。

ex.en: Food waste is a big problem in rich countries.
ex.zh: 食物浪費在富裕國家是個大問題。

ex.en: This meeting is a waste of time.
ex.zh: 這場會議根本是浪費時間。

ex.en: It's a waste to throw away good food.
ex.zh: 把好好的食物丟掉很浪費。

ex.en: A covered walkway connects the two buildings.
ex.zh: 一條有遮蔽的走道連接兩棟大樓。

ex.en: Please keep the walkway clear.
ex.zh: 請保持走道暢通。

ex.en: The bank agreed to waive the fee.
ex.zh: 銀行同意免收手續費。

ex.en: He waived his right to a lawyer.
ex.zh: 他放棄了請律師的權利。

ex.en: Visiting hours in the ward end at 8 p.m.
ex.zh: 病房的探病時間到晚上八點為止。

ex.en: She works as a nurse on the maternity ward.
ex.zh: 她在產科病房當護理師。

ward.zh: ward off：防止、抵擋（疾病、危險）

ex.en: Vitamin C may help ward off colds.
ex.zh: 維他命 C 可能有助於預防感冒。

ex.en: He lit a fire to ward off wild animals.
ex.zh: 他生火來驅趕野生動物。

ex.en: We have a warrant to search your apartment.
ex.zh: 我們有搜索票，要搜查你的公寓。

ex.en: The police issued a warrant for his arrest.
ex.zh: 警方對他發出了逮捕令。

ex.en: The situation does not warrant such a strong reaction.
ex.zh: 這個情況不值得反應這麼激烈。

ex.en: His performance warrants a promotion.
ex.zh: 他的表現值得升遷。

ex.en: I'm wary of you.
ex.zh: 我對你有戒心。

ex.en: Be wary of emails asking for your password.
ex.zh: 要小心那些要你提供密碼的電子郵件。

ex.en: Investors are wary of risky stocks.
ex.zh: 投資人對高風險股票保持警戒。

ex.en: There's a Mr Kay who wants to see you.
ex.zh: 有位凱先生想見你。

ex.en: I finally got hold of that book I wanted.
ex.zh: 我終於拿到我想要的那本書了。

ex.en: You may give this picture to whoever wants it.
ex.zh: 你可以把這張照片送給任何想要的人。

want.zh: want to：想要（做某事）；want sb to：希望某人做

ex.en: "Why aren't you going?" "Because I don't want to."
ex.zh: 「你為什麼不去？」「因為我不想去。」

ex.en: My manager wants me to finish the report today.
ex.zh: 我主管希望我今天完成報告。

ex.en: That way I kill two birds with one stone.
ex.zh: 這樣我就能一石二鳥。

ex.en: This is the best way to learn English.
ex.zh: 這是學英文最好的方法。

ex.en: Could you tell me the way to the station?
ex.zh: 可以告訴我去車站怎麼走嗎？

ex.en: I met Tom on my way to work.
ex.zh: 我在上班的路上遇到湯姆。

ex.en: British English differs from American English in many ways.
ex.zh: 英式英語和美式英語在很多方面不同。

ex.en: In some ways, he is right.
ex.zh: 在某些方面，他是對的。

ex.en: By the way, did you call the client?
ex.zh: 對了，你打電話給客戶了嗎？

ex.en: By the way, the meeting has been moved to Friday.
ex.zh: 順便一提，會議改到星期五了。

ex.en: Air is to us what water is to fish.
ex.zh: 空氣對我們，就像水對魚一樣重要。

ex.en: Can I have a glass of water?
ex.zh: 可以給我一杯水嗎？

ex.en: When was the last time you watered the garden?
ex.zh: 你上次幫花園澆水是什麼時候？

ex.en: The flowers in the garden need watering.
ex.zh: 花園裡的花需要澆水了。

ex.en: He watches at least one movie a day.
ex.zh: 他每天至少看一部電影。

ex.en: I spent Saturday afternoon watching entirely too much TV.
ex.zh: 我星期六下午看了太多電視。

ex.en: Watch your step.
ex.zh: 小心腳步。

ex.en: Could you watch my bag for a minute?
ex.zh: 可以幫我看一下包包嗎？

ex.en: I was given a nice watch by my uncle.
ex.zh: 叔叔送了我一支很漂亮的手錶。

ex.en: My watch is five minutes fast.
ex.zh: 我的手錶快了五分鐘。

ex.en: The old man walked across the road carefully.
ex.zh: 老人小心地走過馬路。

ex.en: Walking along the street, I met an old friend.
ex.zh: 我沿著街道走時，遇見了一位老朋友。

ex.en: When he feels fine, he goes for a walk.
ex.zh: 他心情好的時候會去散步。

ex.en: It is about ten minutes' walk to the station.
ex.zh: 從這裡走到車站大約十分鐘。

ex.en: I walk my dog every evening.
ex.zh: 我每天傍晚遛狗。

ex.en: Let me walk you to the station.
ex.zh: 我陪你走到車站吧。

ex.en: We waited in the park for a long time.
ex.zh: 我們在公園等了很久。

ex.en: I'm sorry to have kept you waiting so long.
ex.zh: 抱歉讓你久等了。

ex.en: Hundreds of people were waiting outside the ticket office.
ex.zh: 售票處外面有數百人在等候。

ex.en: I can't wait to see you.
ex.zh: 我等不及要見到你了。

ex.en: We can't wait for the holidays.
ex.zh: 我們迫不及待想放假了。

ex.en: There's a two-hour wait for a table.
ex.zh: 要等兩個小時才有位子。

ex.en: The wait was worth it.
ex.zh: 等待是值得的。

ex.en: The paper was beginning to peel off the walls.
ex.zh: 壁紙開始從牆上剝落。

ex.en: There is a portrait of Bob on the wall.
ex.zh: 牆上掛著一幅 Bob 的肖像。

ex.en: He painted all the walls green.
ex.zh: 他把所有的牆壁漆成綠色。

ex.en: A warm, sunny day is ideal for a picnic.
ex.zh: 溫暖的晴天最適合野餐。

ex.en: Spring is here. It is getting warmer every day.
ex.zh: 春天來了，天氣一天比一天暖和。

ex.en: Put this jacket on, and you'll be much warmer.
ex.zh: 穿上這件外套，你會暖和很多。

ex.en: Thank you for your warm welcome.
ex.zh: 謝謝你們熱情的歡迎。

ex.en: She has a warm smile.
ex.zh: 她有溫暖的笑容。

ex.en: It has finally stopped snowing and has warmed up.
ex.zh: 雪終於停了，天氣也暖和起來了。

ex.en: I warmed myself in the bath.
ex.zh: 我泡了澡，讓身體暖和起來。

ex.en: I'll warm up the soup for you.
ex.zh: 我幫你把湯熱一下。

ex.en: Our teacher warned him not to be late again.
ex.zh: 老師警告他不要再遲到。

ex.en: I came to warn you not to do that.
ex.zh: 我是來警告你別那樣做的。

ex.en: Before turning, put on your blinkers to warn other drivers.
ex.zh: 轉彎前要打方向燈提醒其他駕駛。

ex.en: Tom left without warning.
ex.zh: 湯姆不告而別。

ex.en: The machine stopped working without warning.
ex.zh: 機器毫無預警地停止運作。

ex.en: Who is that girl waving to you?
ex.zh: 那個在向你揮手的女孩是誰？

ex.en: They waved good-bye to their parents as the train pulled out.
ex.zh: 火車開動時，他們向父母揮手道別。

ex.en: She greeted him waving her hand.
ex.zh: 她揮手跟他打招呼。

ex.en: Can you hear the noise of the waves on the beach?
ex.zh: 你聽得到海浪拍打沙灘的聲音嗎？

ex.en: The waves were too big for swimming.
ex.zh: 浪太大，不能游泳。

ex.en: A cold wave of fear hit me like a brick.
ex.zh: 一陣恐懼像磚頭一樣狠狠砸向我。

ex.en: A heat wave hit the city last week.
ex.zh: 上週一波熱浪襲擊了這座城市。

ex.en: How often do you wash your car a month?
ex.zh: 你一個月洗幾次車？

ex.en: You haven't washed your hands yet, have you?
ex.zh: 你還沒洗手，對吧？

ex.en: My big sister washes her hair every morning.
ex.zh: 我姊姊每天早上都會洗頭。

ex.en: Mummy has to do the washing this afternoon.
ex.zh: 媽媽今天下午要洗衣服。

ex.en: Your blue shirt is still in the wash.
ex.zh: 你的藍襯衫還在洗。

ex.en: I woke up with a headache this morning.
ex.zh: 我今天早上醒來時頭很痛。

ex.en: Sadly, I have to wake up early every day.
ex.zh: 可惜我每天都得早起。

ex.en: I feel as if I've woken up from a nightmare.
ex.zh: 我覺得自己好像剛從惡夢中醒來。

ex.en: I asked Mother to wake me up at four.
ex.zh: 我請媽媽四點叫我起床。

ex.en: Mom wakes me up for school every day.
ex.zh: 媽媽每天叫我起床上學。

ex.en: The minimum wage in Okinawa is 642 yen per hour.
ex.zh: 沖繩的最低工資是每小時 642 日圓。

ex.en: What's the minimum wage in your country?
ex.zh: 你們國家的最低工資是多少？

ex.en: The workers didn't get their basic wage.
ex.zh: 工人拿不到基本工資。

ex.en: The city is waging a campaign against littering.
ex.zh: 市政府正在推動一項反亂丟垃圾的運動。

ex.en: The company waged a long legal battle.
ex.zh: 這家公司打了一場漫長的官司。

ex.en: Sometimes it's fun to just wander about aimlessly.
ex.zh: 有時候漫無目的地閒逛很有趣。

ex.en: We wandered around the old town all afternoon.
ex.zh: 我們整個下午都在老城區閒逛。

ex.en: My mind kept wandering during the long meeting.
ex.zh: 冗長的會議中我一直分心。

ex.en: Let's not wander off the topic.
ex.zh: 我們不要離題。

ex.en: The invention of the smartphone was a watershed in communication.
ex.zh: 智慧型手機的發明是通訊史上的轉捩點。

ex.en: That meeting proved to be a watershed for the company.
ex.zh: 那次會議後來成了公司的轉捩點。

ex.en: The river's watershed covers a huge area.
ex.zh: 這條河的流域面積非常廣大。

ex.en: Protecting the watershed keeps our drinking water clean.
ex.zh: 保護集水區能讓我們的飲用水保持乾淨。

ex.en: Blue light has a shorter wavelength than red light.
ex.zh: 藍光的波長比紅光短。

ex.en: Each radio station broadcasts on a different wavelength.
ex.zh: 每個電台在不同的波長播送。

wavelength.zh: on the same wavelength：想法一致、合得來

ex.en: My manager and I are on the same wavelength.
ex.zh: 我和主管的想法很合拍。

ex.en: It's easy to work with people on your wavelength.
ex.zh: 跟想法相近的人共事很輕鬆。

ex.en: I saw a beautiful waterfall there.
ex.zh: 我在那裡看到一座很美的瀑布。

ex.en: The trail ends at a beautiful waterfall.
ex.zh: 這條步道的終點是一座美麗的瀑布。

ex.en: We took photos in front of the waterfall.
ex.zh: 我們在瀑布前拍照。

ex.en: We stopped at a wayside café for lunch.
ex.zh: 我們在路邊的咖啡館停下來吃午餐。

ex.en: Flowers were growing by the wayside.
ex.zh: 路旁長著花。

wayside.zh: fall by the wayside：半途而廢、被淘汰

ex.en: Many good plans fall by the wayside due to lack of money.
ex.zh: 許多好計畫因缺乏資金而半途而廢。

ex.en: Several start-ups fell by the wayside last year.
ex.zh: 去年好幾家新創公司被淘汰了。

ex.en: He is a waiter in a seaside restaurant.
ex.zh: 他在一家海邊的餐廳當服務生。

ex.en: Waiter, please bring me some water.
ex.zh: 服務生，請給我一些水。

ex.en: Soon the same waiter came back to pick up the dishes.
ex.zh: 沒多久，同一位服務生回來收盤子。

ex.en: Waitress, I'd like to order.
ex.zh: 服務生，我要點餐。

ex.en: The waitress brought us the menu.
ex.zh: 女服務生拿菜單給我們。

ex.en: One million people lost their lives in the war.
ex.zh: 一百萬人在戰爭中喪生。

ex.en: Why are there still wars in the world?
ex.zh: 為什麼這世界上還有戰爭？

ex.en: Germany was allied with Italy in World War II.
ex.zh: 二次大戰時，德國和義大利結盟。

ex.en: The two companies are in a price war.
ex.zh: 這兩家公司正在打價格戰。

ex.en: The government declared war on drugs.
ex.zh: 政府向毒品宣戰。

ex.en: A good warranty would make me feel better.
ex.zh: 有好的保固會讓我比較安心。

ex.en: The laptop comes with a two-year warranty.
ex.zh: 這台筆電有兩年保固。

ex.en: Tom waited for Mary in front of the warehouse.
ex.zh: 湯姆在倉庫前等瑪麗。

ex.en: Who was it that forgot to lock the door of the warehouse?
ex.zh: 是誰忘了把倉庫的門鎖上？

ex.en: Then come with me for a moment. Let's check the warehouse. We might just find it there.
ex.zh: 那您跟我來一下，我們去倉庫找找看，說不定那裡有。

ex.en: Warehousing costs increased after the company expanded.
ex.zh: 公司擴大營運後，倉儲成本也提高了。

ex.en: We use a local firm for warehousing and distribution.
ex.zh: 我們委託當地公司處理倉儲與配送。

ex.en: Waterproof features would be a plus.
ex.zh: 防水功能會是加分項。

ex.en: The contractor used waterproof sealant around the basement windows.
ex.zh: 承包商在地下室窗戶周圍使用防水填縫劑。

ex.en: Could I have a wake-up call at six tomorrow?
ex.zh: 可以麻煩明天六點叫醒我嗎？

ex.en: I asked the front desk for a wake-up call.
ex.zh: 我請櫃檯提供晨喚服務。

ex.en: The accident was a wake-up call for him to drive more carefully.
ex.zh: 那場意外給了他一記警鐘，讓他開車更小心。

ex.en: Losing the client was a wake-up call for the whole team.
ex.zh: 失去那位客戶給整個團隊敲響了警鐘。

ex.en: I've looked everywhere, but I can't find my wallet.
ex.zh: 我到處都找了，就是找不到我的錢包。

ex.en: Our wallets were stolen.
ex.zh: 我們的錢包被偷了。

ex.en: Tom took out his wallet and paid the bill.
ex.zh: 湯姆拿出錢包付了帳。
